conditions.today: Start your week off right by embracing the spring slush vibes at Rendezvous Mountain. A monster high pressure system remains parked over the west, keeping things warm and dry, but a healthy base, a positive attitude, and endless terrain are our recipe for success. Expect consistent high cloud cover throughout the day today. Westerly Winds will be moderate with gusts up to 25mph possible along the ridge tops. Summit temps will kick around the 40s while the base gets tropical at 61 degrees by mid-day. Come and get it! -OH
conditions.yesterday: Spring has sprung in the Tetons and Rendezvous Mountain holds all the secrets to unlock the goods. From high country corn cycles in the morning, to afternoon cruisers in the soft stuff, one thing is for sure, your goggle tan has never looked so good! Look for clear and sunny skies today with calm to moderate winds trending out of the West at 9-12 MPH, afternoon gusts will range from 15-20 MPH. Mountain temperatures will reach the upper 30's at the top Tram dock, while the valley floor will be basking in the mid to upper 50's after lunch. Celebrate skiing in the springtime, as mountain-wide conditions soften up throughout the day and the gentle giant continues to ski well. Stay safe out there and stay stoked in the sunshine! -MB
